title: [tenmin-range-reply-dust] isEmptyTenMinRangeManifest: characterization test for empty and non-empty manifests
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for isEmptyTenMinRangeManifest in src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.ts: empty manifests
- isEmptyTenMinRangeManifest({ schemaVersion: "tenmin-range-reply-dust-manifest-v2", format: "REPLY_DUST_V1_ZSTD19_DICT4K", provider: "p", rangeFrom: "2024-11-01", rangeTo: "2024-12-31", securityCount: 0, fileCount: 0, fallbackFileCount: 0, securities: [], days: [], gaps: [], checksum: "c" }) is true

Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1fbe917, live 28-rule approved list, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v5); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with isEmptyTenMinRangeManifest stubbed); suite 614/614 with all sixteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
